feed.title: LLM Frontier: AA Omniscience advances
feed.subtitle: Each entry is a date on which a model became the cheapest way to reach some level of AA Omniscience, through a release or a price change.

entry.title: 2026-09-03: GPT-6 Astra (high) (new model, AA Omniscience 43.7)
entry.summary: GPT-6 Astra (high): pushed the AA Omniscience ceiling from 43.5 to 43.7, at $0.96 per task, taking it from Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Fable 5, both of which left the frontier. Proprietary.
